extraction.name: Inter-GPS: Interpretable Geometry Problem Solving with Formal Language and Symbolic Reasoning
extraction.description: Geometry3K is a large-scale benchmark consisting of 3,002 geometry problems with dense annotation in formal language, designed for interpretable geometry problem solving.
extraction.creator: Pan Lu, Ran Gong, Shibiao Jiang, Liang Qiu, Siyuan Huang, Xiaodan Liang, Song-Chun Zhu
extraction.publisher: UCLA, Zhejiang University, Sun Yat-sen University, Peking University, Tsinghua University
extraction.citeAs: Lu, P., Gong, R., Jiang, S., Qiu, L., Huang, S., Liang, X., & Zhu, S. C. (2021). Inter-GPS: Interpretable Geometry Problem Solving with Formal Language and Symbolic Reasoning. arXiv preprint arXiv:2105.04165.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The data is collected from two popular textbooks for high school students across grades 6-12 by two online digital libraries (McGraw-Hill and Geometryonline). Groups of well-trained annotators with undergraduate degrees manually collect each problem with its problem text, geometry diagram, four candidate choices, and correct answer.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Two popular high school textbooks and online digital libraries (McGraw-Hill, Geometryonline).
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Problems are divided into train, validation, and test sets with a ratio of 0.7:0.1:0.2. Each problem is annotated with dense formal language descriptions.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Each problem text and diagram is annotated with unified structural descriptions in formal language. Well-trained annotators with undergraduate degrees manually collect the problem text, geometry diagram, four candidate choices, and correct answer. Problems are also labeled with the corresponding problem goal and geometry shapes.
extraction.rai:annotationsPerItem: Multiple annotations per item including problem text, diagram, choices, correct answer, problem goal, geometry shapes, and dense formal language literals for both text and diagram.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The work may inspire follow-up research in symbolic reasoning and interpretable models and facilitate education.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset contains high-school geometry problems. The problems are collected from specific textbooks. The formal language predicates are defined for elementary geometry. The dataset may not generalize to other math domains or complex real-world geometry problems without diagrams.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Testing, Validation, Fine Tuning. The dataset is used to assess algorithms' performance of geometry problem solving, specifically for symbolic reasoning and interpretable problem solving.
